title: Optimal Uniform Pricing for Multi-Interval Dispatch without Make-Whole Uplifts
abstract: arXiv:2609.00541v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: In a network with ramp-limited generators and inaccurate net-demand forecasts, practical rolling-window dispatch can drive locational marginal prices (LMPs) below generators' bid-in offers. In such cases, out-of-market (OOM) settlements are used to compensate generators and maintain dispatch-following incentives, but OOM can have negative consequences, including nontransparent real-time price signals, discriminatory compensation, and incentives for untruthful bidding. This paper presents an optimal uniform pricing rule that minimizes demand payments, eliminates OOM make-whole payments, preserves LMP-based congestion charges, and ensures revenue adequacy. We derive the proposed pricing rule in closed form and relate it to existing pricing schemes. Numerical comparisons demonstrate favorable generator profits and reduced price volatility. translated_title: 无需市场外全额补偿的多区间调度最优统一定价
translated_abstract: 在含有爬坡速率受限发电机以及净需求预测不准确的网络中，实际运行的滚动窗口调度可能使节点边际价格（LMP）低于发电机的申报报价。在这种情况下，市场外（OOM）结算被用于补偿发电机并维持其跟随调度的激励，但市场外结算会带来负面后果，包括不透明的实时价格信号、歧视性的补偿机制，以及对不真实报价行为的激励。本文提出了一种最优统一定价规则，该规则能够最小化需求侧支付、消除市场外全额补偿支付、保留基于LMP的阻塞费用，并确保收入充足性。我们以闭式形式推导了所提出的定价规则，并将其与现有定价方案建立了联系。数值比较表明，该规则能带来更有利的发电机利润和更低的价格波动性。然而，更高的发电机利润伴随着需求侧支付的增加，这反映了市场内（原文此处截断）
tldr: 本文提出一种最优统一定价规则，能够在无需市场外全额补偿的情况下消除LMP低于发电机报价的问题，同时最小化需求侧支付、保留阻塞费用并确保收入充足。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes an optimal uniform pricing rule that eliminates out-of-market make-whole payments in multi-interval dispatch while minimizing demand payments, preserving LMP-based congestion charges, and ensuring revenue adequacy.
